data.name: Key_A103_1
data.value: Added Outbox Sync Logic on Stock Inbound/Outbound

data.name: Key_A104_1
data.value: Added Outbox Sync Logic for StockTransfer and fixed an issue where Mametan search results lost rows due to GroupBy processing in NoFilterMode.

data.name: Key_A108_1
data.value: Added the Arrival & Shipment import feature, improved RadioButton state display, and made various other mobile UI enhancements.

data.name: Key_A108_2
data.value: Added Seuic and Urovo SDK libraries to support hardware scan keys for QR codes and barcodes. Also added a slider setting to adjust scan sound volume.

data.name: Key_A108_3
data.value: Added automatic version checking and support for updating to the latest version.

data.name: Key_A108_4
data.value: Enhanced the ImportTemplate feature by removing the requirement for LineNo input. Instead, PO, InstrNo, GoodsCd, and Total Quantity are now required to retrieve the key.

data.name: Key_C108_1
data.value: Migrated from NPOI to the latest Microsoft OpenXML library to avoid licensing issues associated with NPOI 2.8.0.

data.name: Key_U101_1
data.value: Submit to Headquarters (Multiple Inventory Inbound/Outbound Processing Available)

data.name: Key_U105_1
data.value: Fixed the Outbox Sync logic, corrected the inventory inbound/outbound processing logic in NoFilterMode, and resolved an issue where stock was not deducted for the second and subsequent outbound documents during multiple outbound transactions.

data.name: Key_U106_1
data.value: Improved the QR Scan screen by consolidating records with the same InstrNo, PoNo, GoodsCd, and StockType into a single row.

data.name: Key_U107_1
data.value: Improved the mobile UI, fixed several inventory inbound/outbound processing issues, and resolved an issue when viewing item history.

data.name: Key_U108_1
data.value: Fixed an issue preventing file read/write operations on Android 13, 14, 15, and 16, and added support for the MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission.
